title: Active Phase 3 258-trial 190-field evidence coverage
source: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 plus established dated trial evidence; statuses are not efficacy grades
limitations: 190 columns per study is a structural schema, not 190 independently verified clinical assessments.
A source-only observation does not establish clinical success, drug approval, or a numeric factor grade.
A missing-evidence field is intentionally unscored.
The saved source snapshot is dated, not a continuous live scan.
